text: D206738 reviewer asked to remove a comment about what the code used to do, because that history would confuse future readers, and a comment naming the F5 shortcut, because the shortcut could change. The accepted patch describes the current startup/all-server loop without binding it to a key. This is a supported comment-style rule in this component. The reviewer also asked to remove temporary debug dump calls before landing. The accepted diff contains no added dump calls. Some comments remain verbose, so the review does not prove a strict brevity rule.
title: Keep POP3 comments about current behavior rather than old code or shortcuts
